interpretation: All metrics are descriptive over supplied seeds; ranges are seed ranges, not confidence intervals. Target hit@k is conditional on a detector producing an alarm explanation in that event. Events with target names absent from the HAI CSV schema are excluded rather than mapped by guesswork. The result measures localization of documented target points, not causal root-cause identification.
